notes.title: Small Demo Patch - 30th May 2025
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch notes - 30th May 2025 - v1.0.1.0[/h2]

[h3]Added[/h3]
- Some additional 'Easy'/'Normal' anomalies to replace the ones that were removed.
- Pixel perfect scaling is now an option in the Settings menu. Enabled by default and recommended to leave on.
- Added a 'Back' button to the manual for improved navigation.

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
- Fixed extra line in a tutorial prompt.
- Fixed some anomalies being hidden by other sprites appearing above them.
- Fixed small spacing errors in the manual.

[h3]Changed[/h3]
- Made 'Normal' difficulty slightly easier. This is more representative of the final game's difficulty where there will be three even harder difficulties above 'Normal'.
- Reworked the Settings menu to divide options into tabs.

[h3]Removed[/h3]
- Some anomalies not intended to show on 'Easy'/'Normal' have been removed from the demo.
